ChatGPT powered GRAMMAR CHECKER, AI EMAIL WRITER, PROOFREADER & REPHRASE SENTENCES APP

 Do you need a rewriting and rephrasing AI tool with ChatGPT to improve and adjust your writing? Or maybe you need an AI writing assistant that will rewrite your text to be longer or summarize it to be shorter? Well, PowerPen – the AI Proofreader uses ChatGPT AI technology to paraphrase, fix grammar and spelling, as well as improve the writing in your day-to-day email communication and work/study tasks.

REPHRASE TO IMPROVE YOUR WRITING WITH AI REWORDING & LANGUAGE STYLING

 ⌨️ By utilizing AI rephrasing and proofreading, our ultimate text editing tool with ChatGPT makes language styling as accessible as text styling. Never again you will face uncertainty as a non-native speaker or if your message is acknowledged in the correct language tone or voice. ‣ Edit and style any text: Whether you are writing an email, a tweet, dm, or any social media message, our ChatGPT powered ai writing assistant makes it easy to express yourself in any style and tone, while ensuring your grammar, punctuation, and spelling are perfect. Write a message or email, and hit the Improve Writing button to see the magic of our ai writing paraphrasing tool. ‣ Choose the tone of language: Our paraphraser tool with Chat GPT allows you to select from a variety of language styles, including casual, professional, and intimate, flirty as well as language tones, such as warm, friendly, and passive-aggressive, allowing you to easily convey the right message and make the right impression. It can also implement a direct tone of language with no passive language that can be used for your marketing (sales copy, ads, descriptions, offers, emails). 🔡FIX SPELLING & GRAMMAR WITH OUR AI GRAMMAR CHECKER APP AND PROOFREADER WITH CHATGPT Our rewording ai helper comes with an in-built punctuation corrector, and grammar and spelling checker just so your writing is always perfect. Use the in-built summarizer to summarize long pieces of text for ease of consumption. ⏪SHORTEN TEXT WITH CHATGPT Need to write more concisely in clearer and shorter paragraphs?
